newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia rupiah steady, back to central bank band.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia rupiah steady, back to central bank band.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah was steady against the dollar in moderate early trading on Thursday, with the rupiah returning to within the parameters of the central bank intervention band, dealers said.

Currency dealers in Jakarta said offshore players, mainly from Singapore, were seen trying to create ground for a band widening as they continued to unload dollars in an attempt to strengthen the rupiah.
But the dealers said it was unlikely that the central bank would widen again in the short-term as the band was widened just last September to eight percent from five percent.
"I don't think the central bank would widen its band again at present," one economist attached to a state bank said.
Dealers said offshore players were also seen trying to link a meeting between the central bank and some bank directors on Thursday to a possible announcement of a band widening.

The meeting, scheduled for the afternoon, was a regular meeting between the central bank and some selective banks to exchange information on recent market developments, banking sources in Jakarta said.
"No decision will be made at the meeting," the economist said, adding that it was not a policy-making meeting.
One U.S. bank dealer said offshore players were trying to create reasons to sell dollars and also to challenge the central bank, Bank Indonesia.
"I don't think Bank Indonesia would give in to offshore pressure," he said.
Offshore operators started testing the band late on Wednesday, raising the rupiah out of the central bank's ceiling after the official squaring time at 0900 GMT.
But state bank dealers said the central bank did not intervene, leaving the rupiah trading at 2,318.25 against the dollar in London.
Spot rupiah returned to the central bank's intervention band in early Thursday trading at 2,320.5/21.0 at the opening after factoring in some premiums for longer days.
Spot value on Thursday will be due next Tuesday because of a public holiday in the United States on Monday. Spot rupiah was quoted at 2,320.4/20.5 at 0305 GMT.
Tomorrow and today rupiah were quoted at 2,316.75/17.25 and 2,316.25/16.75, respectively.
Dealers said sentiment on the rupiah remained firm.
They said it was not clear why offshore players tried to spread rumours for another widening.
They said short-dated swaps were still expensive on foreign buying, which also kept longer-term rates high.
Overnight swap was at 0.60/0.65. Tom/next swap rose to 3.3/3.6 points from 2.75/3.0 points at the opening.
One-month swap was quoted at 18.5/19.5, two at 35.0/36.5, three at 53.0/55.0 and six at 102.5/104.5 points.
Bank Indonesia raised its intervention rate by one point to 2,319/2,511 and the conversion rate also by one point to 2,319/2,367 on Wednesday.
